alt_seeds.percentiles: median, 5th, 10th, 90th and 95th by linear interpolation (numpy.percentile); the stored seed's percentile is the percent of the 400 ends below its end, ties counting half
alt_seeds.sd: sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of the 400 interval ends

converged.mc_sd: sd of the interval end over the chunks (each an independent 2000-draw stream under the stored prefix) divided by sqrt(chunks): a quantile's sd falls as 1/sqrt(draws); mc_sd_hi_from_batches is the same from 10 batches of 10 000 draws, as a check

selection.rule: see the header of robustness/seeds_x86.py: F = an in-cache kept cell whose aligned upper end is within near of the forward limit; P = an in-cache kept cell whose hot loops sit differently, whose aligned reading is at or above limit - near (or whose point ratio is above the maximum) and whose placement statistic D has an end within near of 1

what: The x86-64 pool's bootstrap intervals re-drawn under seeds other than the stored one, for the cells whose interval end lies close to the line a rule draws: same data, same code (harness/pool.py unchanged), same number of resamples. A sensitivity reading beside the stored verdicts; it changes no rule, threshold, seed or resample count, and the stored verdicts are the ones in the pool file.
